decision.explanation: Two distinct claims exist in the provided sources regarding the artist of the 'Freedom Suite' album. Document D1S1 and D1S2 explicitly name David S. Ware as the artist, describing him as the saxophonist behind the album. Document D4S2 similarly states that the album is by John Coltrane. These are conflicting assertions about the same referent (the artist of the 'Freedom Suite'), but they pertain to different named individuals. Since the system treats distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers as coexisting, both are preserved without resolution into a single 'winner'.
